page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes down the right margin. A short catchword ("ossibus") sits at the lower right below the last line. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.head: DE COENA DOMINI.

head.i: Qua ratione in Cæna Domini admoneris & confirmaris, te unici illius sacrificij Christi in cru-ce oblati, atque omnium eius bonorum participem esse?

main_text.p: Quód Christus me atq; omnes fideles de hoc fracto pane edere, & de poculo distributo bibere iussit, in sui memoriam, addita hac promissione{b}: Primùm, corpus suum non minùs certò pro me in cruce oblatum ac fractum, & sanguinem suum pro me fusum esse, quàm oculis cerno, panem Domini mihi frangi, & poculum mihi communicari. Deinde animam meam non minùs certò ipsius corpore, quod pro nobis crucifixum, & sanguine, qui pro nobis fusus est, ad vitam æternam ab ipso pasci, quàm panem & vinum, symbola corporis & sanguinis domini, è manu ministri accepta, ore corporis percipio.b Mat.26. 27.28.Mar. 14.22.23. 24.Luc.22. 19.20.1.co. 10.16.17.& 11.23.24. 25.&.12.13

head.i: Quid est crucifixum corpus Christi edere, & fusum eius sanguinem bibere?

main_text.p: Est non tantum totam passionem & mortem Christi certa animi fiducia amplexati, ac per id remissionem peccatorum & vitam æternam adipisci{c}: sed etiam per S. S. qui simul in Christo & in nobis habitat, ita sacrosancto eius corpori magis ac magis vniri{d}, vt quamuis ipse in cœlo{e}, nos vero in terra simus, nihilo-minus tamen, caro simus de carne eius, & os de ossibusc Io.6.35. 40.47.48. 50.51.53. 54.d Io.6.55.56[?]e A&t.3.21. A&t.1.9.1. 1.Co.11.26.

page.notes: Marginal references at the top right ("col.2.11.", "a 2.13.") were tied to the superscript after "Baptismus", whose mark is uncertain. Reference d reads "dio.6.55.66" on the scan and was copied as "Io.6.55.56[?]"; the last digit is doubtful. Note e lines are partly blurred ("A&.1.9.1." may be "Act.1.9.1."). The superscript marks c, d and e are small and were placed by sequence. The final word "ossibus" is printed larger at the lower right and is treated as the catchword.
